clusters.headline: Prime Minister Narendra Modi Visits Bengaluru For Infrastructure Launch
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated an elevated section of the Namma Metro Pink Line in Bengaluru.
The visit included the official launch of the Yeshwantpur-Madgaon Vande Bharat Express railway service.

clusters.headline: Sonam Wangchuk Placed Under House Arrest Amid Ladakh Poll Protests
aiSummaryBullets: Activist Sonam Wangchuk stated he is under house arrest following his removal from a protest site by local police.
Civil society groups are demanding the postponement of Ladakh's hill council elections, citing the harsh winter conditions.

clusters.headline: Delhi Air Quality Reaches Hazardous Levels Following Deepavali
aiSummaryBullets: The Central Pollution Control Board reported Delhi's air quality index reached severe levels, with some areas exceeding an AQI of 450.
Local government officials have begun deploying water sprinkling measures to help mitigate the impact of the toxic smog.

clusters.headline: Sonia Gandhi Memoir Sparks Political Debate And Personal Revelations
aiSummaryBullets: The memoir Belonging: A Journey of Love provides insights into historical political moments, including the 1969 Presidential elections and the 1999 Congress revolt.
Personal anecdotes in the book range from Sonia Gandhi's 1978 visit to Indira Gandhi in Tihar Jail to her reflections on interactions with Pranab Mukherjee.

clusters.headline: India Launches New Bengaluru To Madgaon Vande Bharat Express Train
aiSummaryBullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw officially inaugurated the new Vande Bharat Express service.
The train connects Bengaluru, Mangaluru, and Madgaon, operating as part of the nationwide railway network expansion.

clusters.headline: Calcutta High Court Demands List Of Judges From Abhishek Banerjee
aiSummaryBullets: The Calcutta High Court requested Abhishek Banerjee to substantiate claims of judicial bias against the governing party.
Banerjee previously expressed dissatisfaction with the judiciary's response to security threats at his Kolkata residence.

clusters.headline: Indian Government Extends Ban On Islamic Research Foundation Again
aiSummaryBullets: The Indian Ministry of Home Affairs has formally extended the prohibition of the Islamic Research Foundation.
This latest directive marks the third time authorities have prolonged the ban against the organization.

clusters.headline: Multiple Passenger Train Derailments Reported Across Indian States
aiSummaryBullets: The Sairang-Kolkata Express derailed in Assam, resulting in multiple injuries and raising questions about recent track inspection procedures.
Four coaches of the Chauri Chaura Express derailed near Kanpur Central station shortly after departure, though no injuries were reported.

clusters.headline: Diverse Administrative And Legal Developments In Tamil Nadu State
aiSummaryBullets: Legal proceedings have advanced in corruption cases involving public officials and a library book procurement investigation.
The state government has announced economic investments and welfare measures, including school cake distributions and compensation for past protests.

clusters.headline: Indian Agricultural Sector Achieves Growth Exceeding Four Percent
aiSummaryBullets: India has recorded over four percent growth in the agricultural sector for the first time since independence.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that the central government absorbed 43 rupees of the diesel price increase.
